record.one_liner: Ramp: spend management, corporate cards, bill pay and expense reporting for businesses, with a Developer API for Transactions, Reimbursements, Cards and other business data.
record.auth_notes: Client Credentials: client_id:client_secret sent as Basic auth to /developer/v1/token for a bearer token (server-to-server, no user consent). Authorization Code (with optional Refresh Token) for third-party apps with user consent. The Basic-auth client secret is treated as api_key per rubric; the token exchange is OAuth 2.0, so oauth2 is also listed. Borderline on the api_key classification.
record.access_notes: Admin creates a developer app under Company > Developer in the Ramp dashboard. Sandbox is available via a separate sandbox access request (a request step, not verified as approval-gated). Whether production API use needs a paid plan or approval was not confirmed in fetched pages; Ramp Free plan is listed at $0/mo/user on the pricing page but the page does not state API access tier.
record.api_notes: REST endpoints on api.ramp.com (sandbox demo-api.ramp.com); OpenAPI spec published at /openapi/developer-api.json. Product areas listed in docs include Banking, Bill Pay, Cards, Procurement, Reimbursements, Spend Controls and Users. Breadth not fully audited; rated moderate as a judgement call.
record.blocker_notes: No blocker found in fetched pages. Production approval step for third-party distribution was not verified.
